name: signalk-mcp
description: Native Signal K MCP gateway for telemetry, history and notifications, with individual admin approval for every plugin GET/POST and native PUT, plus native permissions.

scripts.lint: eslint src test ui scripts webpack.config.cjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/approvals.test.cjs test/configuration-ui.test.cjs test/security.test.cjs test/capabilities.test.cjs test/history.test.cjs test/notifications.test.cjs test/release.test.cjs test/puts.test.cjs test/plugin-posts.test.cjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --test --test-force-exit test/integration.test.cjs test/hosting.test.cjs test/production-plugin.test.cjs test/runtime.test.cjs test/notifications-native.test.cjs test/restart.test.cjs test/native-puts.test.cjs test/native-posts.test.cjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:integration
